semantics.binding_rule: Instance may reference an explicit AccessCore parent/policy authority according to deployment policy.
semantics.separation_rule: AC parent is not inferred from IAM parent.
semantics.policy_rule: Parent relationship determines only declared AccessCore policy inheritance/delegation semantics.
semantics.nonexpansion_rule: Delegated remote/nonlocal rights cannot silently expand beyond explicit delegation rules.
semantics.local_rule: Local owner may grant broader local rights where the active AccessCore policy explicitly permits that model.
semantics.change_rule: Changing AC parent is an explicit policy/configuration operation with validation/audit.
semantics.failure_rule: Unresolved/invalid parent fails closed for governed authorization paths.

invariants.rule: AIGMos instance identity, configuration, IAM parent, AccessCore parent and runtime state remain explicit separate dimensions; configuration never silently changes semantic ownership or authority.

hard_gates.condition: AC parent inferred from IAM parent

references.purpose: AC parent binds to explicit AccessCore policy identity.
